text:
[Act: cpc
 Chapter: Appeals from Original Decrees
 Section: O41R8::Exercise of power in appeal from order made in execution of decree.
]


The powers conferred by rules 5 and 6 shall be exercisable where an appeal may be or has been preferred not from the decree but from an order made in execution of such decree.

metadata.section_title: Exercise of power in appeal from order made in execution of decree.
